purpose: Teach: 小平/小樽/明石/近江/杉並/伏見/新庄/川越

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 小平の研究所と打ち合わせしましょう
lines.en: Let's set up a meeting with the Kodaira research facility.
lines.style: Crisp, forward-moving. Light authority without edge. Eyes on the next item. Efficient pace, minimal breath between phrases.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。小樽支店の年末キャンペーンを企画します
lines.en: Yes. I'll plan the year-end campaign for the Otaru branch.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment. Warm competence. Pen already moving. Not questioning, just executing. Steady, reliable cadence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 明石市の工場改修プランを進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward with the Akashi factory renovation plan.
lines.style: Clear direction. Slightly raised energy. Lean forward slightly in the voice. No hesitation. Professional but not cold—this matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。近江商人の経営理念を社員研修に取り入れます
lines.en: Yes. I'll incorporate Omi merchant business philosophy into our staff training.
lines.style: Attentive confirmation. Note the specificity—he's listening closely to what she prioritizes. Controlled enthusiasm. Businesslike but engaged.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 杉並区のショールームの内装を整えましょう
lines.en: Let's finalize the interior design for the Suginami showroom.
lines.style: Measured direction. Slight uptick on the verb—this needs doing. Not rushed, but purposeful. Voice stays level and assured.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。伏見の取引先との宴席を準備します
lines.en: Yes. I'll arrange the client dinner with our Fushimi partners.
lines.style: Straight confirmation. Slightly warmer than the previous line—this one has a relational element. Easy competence. Efficient.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新庄の物流センターの稼働状況を確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's check on the operational status of the Shinjo logistics center.
lines.style: Steady directive. Professional tempo. Eyes moving down the list. No strain—this is routine management. Calm authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。川越支店の月次報告を確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll review the monthly report from the Kawagoe branch.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Slight wind-down in energy—we're near the end of the list. Still attentive, but the pace has finished its work. Close.
